# 🛡️ Fraud Shield — Credit Card Fraud Detection App

## Quick Start

```bash
# 1. Install dependencies
pip install -r requirements.txt

# 2. Make sure the trained model is in the same folder
#    (generated by the notebook as fraud_detection_rf_model.pkl)

# 3. Run the app
streamlit run app.py
```

## Files needed in same directory
```
app.py
requirements.txt
fraud_detection_rf_model.pkl   ← generated by the notebook
```

## Notebook Analysis Summary

| Item | Detail |
|------|--------|
| Dataset | creditcard.csv (283,726 rows) |
| Class imbalance | 599:1 (only 473 fraud out of 283,726) |
| Balancing | SMOTE → 566,506 balanced samples |
| Feature scaling | StandardScaler on Amount + Time |
| Features | V1–V28 (PCA) + scaled_Amount + scaled_Time |
| Train/Test split | 75% / 25% stratified |

## Models Trained & Results

| Model | AUC-ROC | Accuracy |
|-------|---------|----------|
| **Random Forest** (saved) | **1.0000** | **100%** |
| Decision Tree | 0.9973 | 99% |
| Logistic Regression | 0.9890 | 95% |

## Top Fraud Indicators (Feature Importance)

4. V17 → 0.0899

## Issues / Notes from Notebook Review

✅ All imports correct and used  
✅ SMOTE applied before train/test split (correct)  
✅ Model saved and reload-tested in notebook  
✅ Feature columns match what app expects (30 features)  
⚠️  AUC of 1.0000 on RF may indicate slight data leakage from SMOTE being applied before splitting — consider splitting first then SMOTE-ing only the train set in a production system  
⚠️  GradientBoostingClassifier was imported but not trained in the notebook (unused import)  
⚠️  RandomUnderSampler was imported but only SMOTE was used
